SOL OBSERVABLE SEPARATION V1 — 9 OCTOBER 2026
Status: internally derived constructive finite certificate. Exact rational replay is being written next. No novelty, external validation, practical efficiency, or universal physical interpretation is claimed.

THE CONCRETE RESULT
The 10-state rational model in work/sol/hidden_realization/exact_certificate_v1.json admits a SINGLE bounded statistic of its observed six-letter process, using seven fixed times, whose expectation is nonnegative for every stationary all-even equilibrium hidden CTMC, with no hidden-dimension or rate bound, but strictly negative for this model. Every reflected cylinder Gram kernel of this model is nevertheless completely positive, by the lead's exact observable-subspace proof.

All coefficients below are rational: use polynomial matrix exponentials, not exact matrix exponentials, when defining the statistic. The statistic can be evaluated from observed letters alone. A deliberately coarse certified normalization gives a positive entropy-production floor at least 2*10^(-89) nats per model time unit for every compatible stationary finite all-even CTMC. The numerical floor is extremely small. Independent-window Hoeffding acquisition at 95% confidence costs about 1.1*10^93 windows, and the smallest lag is 10^(-12). This is a constructive mathematical separation certificate, not a practical experiment or optimized inference scheme.

1. EXACT INPUT AND NOTATION
Take Q,H,M,L, five planar circle vertices v_i, and Farkas z_i from the lead's exact JSON. Its standard-library rational verifier confirms QH=HL, uniform stationary mass 1/10 on the ten hidden states, and ML=L^TM. Outputs are 0 on hidden states i=0,...,4 and k+1 on marker state 5+k, k=0,...,4. The observable feature vector at a hidden state is
  xi_i=(1,v_i^x,v_i^y,0,0,0,0,0) for internal i,
  xi_(5+k)=(0,0,0,e_k) for markers.
The full Farkas field is
  Z_i=(0,z_i^x,z_i^y,(z_i dot v_i)1_5),
  Z_(5+k)=0.
Every pair (xi_i,xi_j) has (Z_i-Z_j) dot (xi_i-xi_j)>=0. Internal pairs are strictly positive; internal-marker pairs are zero. Define
  gamma= -sum_i (1/10) Z_i dot (-L^T xi_i)
       = -farkas_drift_pairing/2 > 59/10000.
Thus F(t)=sum_internal (1/10) Z_i dot (I-exp(tL^T))xi_i has F'(0)=-gamma.

The following exact elementary bounds suffice; the next replay script will verify them from fractions:
  ||L||_F < 3, ||Q||_infinity <=2, max_i ||

SOL OBSERVABLE SEPARATION V2 — EXACT REPLAY AND PROOF CLARIFICATIONS
9 October 2026. Append-only supplement to v1; no changed theorem or numerical constants.

COMPLETED ARTIFACTS
  work/sol/observable_separation/build_and_verify_witness_v1.py
  work/sol/observable_separation/witness_rational_v1.json
The generator/checker uses only Python standard-library fractions.Fraction. It verifies the seed-dependent algebra and every coefficient bound in v1, then constructs the full rational feature, facet-residual, regression and quadratic-interpolation coefficients. It refuses to overwrite a differing existing coefficient artifact. Run:
  python3 work/sol/observable_separation/build_and_verify_witness_v1.py
The frozen coefficient artifact is 86976 bytes; SHA256
  2e9f7eb0e67839b60c5345f42b4bb6b764053bae32f72aeabbaa960b89fd0123

REPLAY RESULT
Exact rational comparisons all passed. Decimal summaries, for readability only:
  full finite drift upper bound: -1.968761546566417e-6,
  raw observable-witness upper bound: -1.173761546566417e-6,
  observed-statistic supremum upper bound: 4.9612680000577e39,
  chosen normalization M: 6e39,
  certified normalized gap: 1/(6*10^45)=1.6666666666666667e-46,
  entropy-production lower bound from the exact span: 2.777777775e-89,
  independent windows for 95-percent two-sided Hoeffding accuracy: 1.0623972827848136e93.
The user-facing conservative claims remain raw gap 1e-6, EP floor >2e-89, and approximately 1.1e93 independent windows. The source seed's exact Fraction verifier also passed in the same verification batch.

CLARIFICATION 1 — THE q COMPARISON USES TWO STAGES
The projection point y=proj_P x and its rounded vertex v must be inserted explicitly:
  q(x)-q(v)=[q(x)-q(y)]+[q(y)-q(v)].
Because |y|<=1,
  q(x)-q(y)>=-(1+|x|)|x-y|,
  q(y)-q(v)>=-2|y-v|>=-16(1-|y|^2).
The rounded drift/coupling cost is -7|x-v|>=-7|x-y|-56(1-|y|^2). Their sum is
  -(8+|x|)|x-y|-72(1-|y|^2),
which is exactly v1 Section5 before inequality (C). A direct one-step application to q(x)-q(v) would introduce an uncontrolled factor |x| multiplying the circle defect; that is not the proof used here.

CLARIFICATION 2 — TARGET REFLECTION NORMS DO NOT ASSUME HIDDEN REVERSIBILITY
